## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      1 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Sep 20, 2026 - Sep 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Working Account_, Sep 20, 2026, 5/5: "For the first few days, you can watch the instruction videos in the app, but after that, if you want to see the instructions, the app automatically redirects you to YouTube. And in the middle of a workout, when you're in the zone, annoying ads pop up. This is a free-tier app that already shows ads, so it's not like I'm using it without giving anything in return. Please do something about this."
<!--/ir-theme-->
